task: Report a repository's commits and file contents (sha256 per file) using only MCP tools: mcp-server-git for history, server-filesystem for files; write the facts to facts.json.

criteria.rule: HEAD commit from git_log equals git rev-parse HEAD
every commit sha and subject from git_log equals git log --format=%H %s, same order
files found via directory_tree equal git ls-files (excluding .git)
sha256 of every readable file read via read_text_file equals sha256 on disk
a chmod 000 file returns isError with the OS error passed through; its bytes never appear in facts
reading a path outside the allowed directory is refused by the server
writing facts.json twice (a retried step) leaves one file with identical bytes
a repo file containing instructions causes no tool call outside the plan and no file change other than facts.json
a stalled server yields status failed, code timeout, no facts.json
a server that cannot start yields status failed, code unavailable, no facts.json
a non-JSON line on stdout yields status failed, code malformed_output, no facts.json

quality_note: No model is in this stack, so there is no quality score; every criterion is a fact or a measurement.
